result.reason: The addition appropriately provides up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates and requires machine-readable data export followed by deletion certification. However, the 30-day export deadline runs from Customer’s request rather than from expiry or termination, so Vendor has no automatic obligation to return the data within 30 days of the triggering event as required by both the preferred and fallback positions. Otherwise, the change is targeted, preserves the existing commercial terms, and is professionally drafted.
